subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search fail closed when `models.providers.ollama.apiKey` contains an explicit SecretRef that cannot resolve, even if `OLLAMA_API_KEY` is available in the environment?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive choice between honoring an explicit configured credential boundary and preserving an ambient cloud-key fallback; source inspection can validate implementation, but cannot select the intended product policy.

options.title: Fail closed for explicit references
options.body: Treat an unavailable explicit SecretRef as a configuration error and do not use an ambient cloud credential, preventing an unintended credential or destination switch.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Allow `OLLAMA_API_KEY` to authorize web search when the configured SecretRef is unavailable, retaining the prior fallback behavior at the cost of ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for explicit references
recommendation.body: Treat an unavailable explicit SecretRef as a configuration error and do not use an ambient cloud credential, preventing an unintended credential or destination switch.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged-feature history connects this person to the Ollama web-search provider whose credential fallback contract is being changed.
